body.x: LOS ANGELES, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> SunBrite reveals its 55-inch all-weather HDTV '5510HD' at the upcoming CES 2010, which is designed specifically for outdoor use. The TV can withstand dust, water, heat, and cold temperatures without any issues thanks to being sealed. The enclosure has fans to keep the TV cool in temps up to 122 degrees.

The SunBrite 5510HD TV supports full 1080p HD resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate and 4000:1 contrast ratio. Other features included four HDMI connections, component, VGA, s-video, composite, RF, RS232, and discreet IR control. It is now available for $7195.
